duplication_audit.novel_axis: case-local normalized bispectral coupling among envelope-frequency triads of the historical significant-wave-height path
duplication_audit.distinction: Ordinary spectral features retain second-order power only; cross-wavelet phase is pairwise cross-channel phase; DCCA is detrended second-order covariance; bicoherence is a normalized third-order statistic for quadratic phase coupling and non-Gaussianity.

rejected_axes.wavelet_bicoherence: would reuse the closed v27/v28 wavelet kernel lineage; fixed Fourier bicoherence isolates the higher-order statistic
rejected_axes.posthoc_bicoherence_router: routing on the exposed surface is forbidden

encoder.input: historical hs at its native 20-minute rows from the past-only 48h context

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Raghuveer and Nikias, Bispectrum estimation: A parametric approach, IEEE TASSP 33(5), 1213-1230 (1985)
Ma et al., Experimental study of wave-wave nonlinear interactions using the wavelet-based bicoherence, Coastal Engineering 55, 741-752 (2008)
